name: pluto-syntax-highlighting
description: Language support for Pluto, a Lua dialect: syntax highlighting, snippets, completion, hover, signature help, go to definition & outline.

pluto.index.enabled.description: Index all Pluto files of the workspace to provide completion, hover and navigation across files. When disabled, only open files are analyzed.

pluto.index.includeLua.description: Also index .lua files, so that Lua modules used from Pluto code are known.

pluto.index.exclude.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#pluto.workspace.exclude#` instead. Patterns set here are still applied.
pluto.index.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of files and folders to leave out of the index.

pluto.workspace.useGitignore.markdownDescription: Leave files matched by the `.gitignore` in the root of the workspace folder out of the index. When disabled, `.gitignore` is not read even if it is listed in `#pluto.workspace.ignoreFiles#`.

pluto.workspace.ignoreFiles.markdownDescription: Ignore files with `.gitignore` syntax, relative to the root of the workspace folder, whose patterns are left out of the index. Changes to these files are applied automatically.

pluto.workspace.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of files and folders to leave out of the index, relative to the workspace folder, e.g. `**/vendor/**` or `build/**`. `files.exclude` always applies; `node_modules`, `.git` and `.vs` are always excluded.

pluto.workspace.useSearchExclude.markdownDescription: Also leave out files matched by `#search.exclude#`.

pluto.index.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to index per workspace.

pluto.completion.documentWords.description: Suggest other words of the current document.

pluto.outline.localVariables.description: Show local variables declared inside functions and blocks in the Outline and breadcrumbs. File-level variables are always shown.

pluto.outline.loopVariables.markdownDescription: Show loop variables (`for i = ...`, `for k, v in ...`) in the Outline.

pluto.outline.parameters.description: Show function parameters as children of their function in the Outline.

pluto.outline.anonymousFunctions.markdownDescription: Show anonymous functions and block lambdas, e.g. `scheduler:add() callback`, in the Outline.

pluto.outline.fields.markdownDescription: Show fields assigned via `self.name = ...` as members of their class in the Outline.

pluto.outline.showValues.markdownDescription: Show the initial value of variables and fields next to their name in the Outline, e.g. `count = 0`.

enumDescriptions: File name and line, e.g. `VehicleManager.pluto:75`. The full path is shown when pointing at the link.
Path relative to the workspace and line, e.g. `src/lib/game/VehicleManager.pluto:75`.
Don't show where a declaration comes from.
pluto.hover.sourcePath.markdownDescription: How hovers and completion details link to a declaration in another file. Declarations in the current file always show just `Line N`.

pluto.autoCloseBlocks.markdownDescription: Insert the matching `end` (or `until`) when pressing Enter after a block opener such as `function`, `if ... then`, `for ... do`, `class` or `switch ... do`.
